_about: Icon refresh map read by Tools/EBMC/build_icons.py. Keys are paths under StaticData/Icons and must name existing .png files there, except directly inside Shapes/ (the shapes palette's own glyphs), where build_icons.py creates them. source is lucide:<name> (Tools/EBMC/icons/lucide/<name>.svg, 46 vendored files) or custom:<name> (Tools/EBMC/icons/custom/<name>.svg, 22 EBMC drawings). size is the output PNG edge in pixels: 64 for icons the code loads at 16x16, 56 for 14x14 (4x the logical size). At device scale 1 the app's loader halves these exactly (64->32->16). At device scale 2 it first resamples the source up by 2 (64->128, bilinear) and then halves it twice to 32 px, so the result is close to, but slightly softer than, an exact 2x box reduction. previously_untinted marks icons whose code did not tint them before the refresh (used only by the preview sheet). Shapes/ glyphs are 80 px masters for 20 px palette buttons; the palette loads them with its own loader, which box-halves straight to the device size, so 1x and 2x are both exact.
